name: text-spinner
title: Text Spinner
description: The one inline text loader: a monospace braille spinner (⠋ ⠙ ⠹ …) one character wide, or three dots, CSS only, a still … under reduced motion.

meta.whenToUse: The one moving thing on a chat turn's live line, Send while it sends, or dots before the first event ("·· Thinking", "·· Reconnecting").
meta.whenNotToUse: Page or section loading (Spinner), a running task-list or Subagent row (StatusGlyph running, drawn still), or progress with a known amount (Progress).
